column3: INDIAN-NAME-ALIAS (gourds-24; counted separately, not a head): PROTA4U Lagenaria siceraria (https://prota.prota4u.org/protav8.asp?g=pe&p=Lagenaria+siceraria) vernacular names "Bottle gourd, calabash gourd, common gourd, white-flowered gourd (En)"; FDC SR Legacy 169232 "Gourd, white-flowered (calabash), raw" (naming only). Recognition routing only: the white-flowered gourd row's placement and conditions apply unchanged.

INDIAN-NAME-ALIAS (gourds-24; counted separately, not a head): PROTA4U Lagenaria siceraria (https://prota.prota4u.org/protav8.asp?g=pe&p=Lagenaria+siceraria) vernacular names "Bottle gourd, calabash gourd, common gourd, white-flowered gourd (En)" (bare "calabash" is not aliased: it can also name other fruits). Recognition routing only: the white-flowered gourd row's placement and conditions apply unchanged.

INDIAN-NAME-ALIAS (gourds-24; counted separately, not a head): PROTA4U Momordica charantia (https://prota.prota4u.org/protav8.asp?g=pe&p=Momordica+charantia) vernacular names "Bitter gourd, balsam pear, bitter melon, karela, African cucumber (En)"; FDC SR Legacy 168393 "Balsam-pear (bitter gourd), pods, raw" (naming only). Recognition routing only: the balsam-pear row's placement and conditions apply unchanged.

Recognition routing only: the balsam-pear row's placement and conditions apply unchanged.

INDIAN-NAME-ALIAS (gourds-24; counted separately, not a head): Spelling variant of PROTA4U's "ridged gourd" for Luffa acutangula (https://prota.prota4u.org/protav8.asp?g=pe&p=Luffa+acutangula). Recognition routing only: the ridged gourd row's placement and conditions apply unchanged.

INDIAN-NAME-ALIAS (gourds-24; counted separately, not a head): PROTA4U Coccinia grandis (https://prota.prota4u.org/protav8.asp?g=pe&p=Coccinia+grandis) vernacular names "Ivy gourd, scarlet-fruited gourd, tindori (En)". Recognition routing only: the ivy gourd row's placement and conditions apply unchanged.
